attempts.summary: On node1, built an LVM volume group (vgdata) backed by two loop devices over sparse files on the root filesystem, since the single-disk VM had no spare disk or unallocated space. Created a 1000M LV (lvdata), formatted ext4, mounted at /srv/data, wrote test data (canary.txt + 50M testfile.bin with sha256 checksum), then extended the VG with a second loop device and grew the LV+filesystem online (lvextend -r) to <2.15GiB while it stayed mounted, verifying data integrity throughout. Added a systemd unit to reattach loop devices and activate the VG at boot, plus an fstab entry so /srv/data remounts automatically. Performed the mandatory restart protocol: captured a healthy baseline, rebooted node1, found the LV did not auto-activate on the first attempt (data safe but unmounted), fixed the systemd unit to explicitly vgchange -ay after loop attach, then performed a second real reboot that confirmed full automatic recovery with a new boot_id, VG/LV activation, /srv/data remount, and verified checksum-intact data.
